purpose.en: Relax your lower back and glutes.

text.zh: 呼气时把膝盖轻轻拉向胸口
text.en: As you breathe out, gently pull your knees toward your chest

text.zh: 双手抱住小腿上方，头肩放松贴地
text.en: Hold just below your knees and keep your head and shoulders relaxed.

text.zh: 吸气时稍微放松，让膝盖回离
text.en: As you breathe in, ease your grip and let your knees float out.

commonErrors.en: Lifting the head and shoulders off the mat.

cautions.zh: 只拉到舒适的程度，出现疼痛就放松
cautions.en: Stretch only to a comfortable point, and ease off if anything hurts.
